description: This PHP class 'tlIssueTracker' manages issue tracker integrations within the TestLink project, including system configurations, CRUD operations, linking to test projects, and environment checks.

classes.name: tlIssueTracker
classes.description: A class for managing issue tracker integrations, configurations, and interactions within the TestLink testing framework.

methods.name: getSystems
methods.description: Returns configured issue tracker systems filtered by enabled/disabled status.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns a mapping of system codes to their type and interface info.

methods.name: getImplementationForType
methods.description: Returns the class name of the implementation interface for a given issue tracker type.

methods.name: getEntitySpec
methods.description: Returns the entity specification array for issue tracker entities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new issue tracker configuration after validation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing issue tracker configuration with validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an issue tracker configuration if not linked to test projects.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Retrieves an issue tracker record by its ID.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves an issue tracker record by its name.

methods.name: getByAttr
methods.description: Retrieves an issue tracker record by specified attribute.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates input object for database operations.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Links an issue tracker to a test project.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Unlinks an issue tracker from a test project.

methods.name: getLinks
methods.description: Retrieves linked test projects for a given issue tracker.

methods.name: getLinkSet
methods.description: Retrieves all issue tracker to test project link mappings.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all issue trackers with optional filters and environment checks.

methods.name: getLinkedTo
methods.description: Gets the issue tracker linked to a specific test project.

methods.name: getInterfaceObject
methods.description: Returns the interface object for an issue tracker, caching in session.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks if the issue tracker connection is active.

methods.name: checkXMLCfg
methods.description: Validates an XML configuration string for correctness.
